# DERIVED EDGE-CASE FIXTURE.
# Purpose: max_drones= sets a regular zone's capacity; on start/end hubs it is
# ignored (terminals are unlimited). A zone with no max_drones stays None,
# which means the default (1) in later slices.
nb_drones: 3
start_hub: start 0 0 [max_drones=9]
hub: narrow 1 0 [max_drones=2]
hub: wide 2 0 [zone=priority]
end_hub: goal 3 0 [max_drones=7]
connection: start-narrow
connection: narrow-wide
connection: wide-goal
